question: The Indian political system is often described as a federal system with a strong unitary bias. Which feature gives it this unitary bias?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Single Citizenship.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Single Citizenship is defined as every citizen of India holds only one citizenship i.e. is of India rather than that of any state.
 
• This implies that all citizens share the same legal rights, obligations, and protections, promoting a unified national identity.
 
• Part II of Constitution incudes articles related to citizenship. These are: 
 
 
• **Article 5**: Provides for citizenship for individuals who were born in India or have Indian parents, and outlines the conditions for citizenship at the time of the Constitution's adoption in 1950.
 
• **Article 6**: Addresses the citizenship of people who migrated from Pakistan to India during the partition.
 
• **Article 7**: Covers those who migrated from India to Pakistan and later returned.
 
• **Article 8**: Provides for citizenship for individuals of Indian origin residing outside India.
 
• **Article 9**: States that anyone who voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country will lose Indian citizenship.
 
• **Articles 10 and 11**: Discuss the rights of citizenship and empower Parliament to make provisions for citizenship.
 
 
 
• Single citizenship fosters a sense of national identity and unity among the diverse population of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Concurrent List** is enumerated in the **Seventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution**. 
 
• **Article ****246(2): **provides that both **Parliament and State Legislatures** can make laws relating to any of the matters enumerated in the Concurrent List.
 
• The Concurrent List originally had 47 items, but now it has 52 subjects ranging from** criminal law and procedure to marriage and divorce, bankruptcy and insolvency, trusts and trustees, and education**.
 
• The **State Lis**t is mentioned in the **Seventh Schedule** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The State List contains** 66 subjects**.
 
• **Article 246(3)** provides that the legislature of any state has exclusive power to make laws with respect to any of the matters enumerated in the State List.
 
• **Dual citizenship** (or dual nationality) refers to the status of an individual who is a citizen of two different countries at the same time.
 
• **The Citizenship Act, 1955,** provides for the acquisition of Indian citizenship** by birth, descent, registration, naturalization, and incorporation of territory,** also **for renouncing or terminating Indian citizenship.**
 
• India does not permit dual citizenship.
